lines.zh: 我在空谷里滑行，翼膜张开。
lines.en: I glide through the hollow vale, membranes spread.

lines.zh: 我的影子把石壁盖住了。
lines.en: My shadow covers the rock wall.
I skim beneath the cave roof.
When I move, the air itself rings.
I sink in a slow spiral.
I glide toward your side.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，声音都变了。
lines.en: Where I pass, all sound changes.
I bank slowly into a turn.
I dip low and rise again.
My wingtip scrapes the stone.
I steady in the air and wait.
I drift toward the sound.
Dust is pushed aside as I pass.
I sweep over your head.

lines.zh: 我的翼膜扫过洞顶的钟乳。
lines.en: My wing membrane brushes the stalactites.
I lower my body and push forward.
I hang in the middle of the vale.
My membranes barely move.
I give off a very low tone.
I am listening to the deep.
My body is blacker than the night.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地呼吸，胸口起伏。
lines.en: I breathe slowly, my chest rising.

lines.zh: 我在等一个会响的东西。
lines.en: I wait for something that makes noise.

lines.zh: 我的爪子垂着，收得很紧。
lines.en: My claws hang, held tight.
I turn my head aside and fix on you.
Something dark flows over my body.
I hang there a long time without moving.

lines.zh: 我的翅在空气里画了一个弧。
lines.en: My wing draws an arc in the air.

lines.zh: 我的翼膜一动不动，没有声。
lines.en: My membranes hang still and silent.
I wait for the smell of blood.
You make a great deal of noise.
My sound waves find heartbeats.
I hang my head down at you.
You stand in my hollow vale.

lines.zh: 你抬头看见的只是黑影。
lines.en: Look up and you see only shadow.
I could pick you up.
I have noted the sound of you.
I am larger than you think.
You give off heat.

lines.zh: 半血之后，我全身会变黑。
lines.en: Below half health, I turn all black.

lines.zh: 我偏了一下，翼收了半张。
lines.en: I bank and half-fold a wing.
I give a shrill tone.
I pull back and hover again.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的声音乱了。
lines.en: That scrambled my sound.
I drop a little lower.

lines.zh: 翼上裂了道口，音波漏出去。
lines.en: A rip in my wing lets the sound escape.
I slowly correct my balance.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身体，黑雾散开。
lines.en: I shake and the dark mist thins.
Not a bad hit.
I slip back into the vale's dark.
There is noise over there; I will look.

lines.zh: 你手上那东西响得刺耳。
lines.en: That thing in your hand rang harshly.
One step from you, and I know.

lines.zh: 你火把的噼啪，我听见了。
lines.en: I hear the crackle of your torch.
The more you knock, the faster I come.
That torch, I do not like it.
Your companions are at the other end.

lines.zh: 我听见那声音在你手里。
lines.en: I hear that sound in your hand.
That echo was mine.
You are moving; good.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，风都被带起来。
lines.en: I hit you and the wind comes with me.
My membrane sweeps across your face.

lines.zh: 你撞进我的翼膜，黏住了。
lines.en: You hit my wing membrane and stick.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，像撞上一块黑。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting blackness.

lines.zh: 我被你撞得一偏，又稳住。
lines.en: You knock me aside and I steady.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，空气里一阵闷响。
lines.en: We collide with a muffled boom.
My claws rake your armour.
A wing shove takes you back two steps.
After we part, I am still above you.
You raise your sword; a wing blocks it.
There is only one of me in this vale.
I was bought with a sacrifice.
That does not concern me.
Swallow that question.
I climb slowly to the roof.
I do not answer; I listen.
This vale is quiet, just right.
I turn away in silence.
You are asking the wrong creature.
I spread my wings and ignore you.
I hook it up and lift.
I hold it in my talons.
This makes noise; I want it.
I throw it into the depths.
I carry it on a circuit.
I pick it up, claws sinking in.
This one is too small.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西我不客气。
lines.en: I do not refuse what falls.
I set it down, gently.
That is a fine sound.
I have locked onto your sound.

lines.zh: 我循着你的脚步降下去。
lines.en: I descend along the sound of your steps.
You are already in this vale.
This target makes noise.
I spread my wings and look down.
I hear where you are.

lines.zh: 我锁住了你心跳的回声。
lines.en: I've caught the echo of your heartbeat.
I can pick out your heat.
I chose you because you move.

lines.zh: 目标就是那个有声音的。
lines.en: The target is the one with sound.

lines.zh: 我的音波贴着石壁追你。
lines.en: My sound wave chases you along the walls.

lines.zh: 你每迈一步，我就压低一寸。
lines.en: Each step you take, I sink an inch lower.
You run, and I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 你躲到石后，我从上面看。
lines.en: You hide behind stone; I watch from above.
My sound follows you.
You look up and I move.

lines.zh: 我一边滑翔一边等你累。
lines.en: I glide and wait for you to tire.
You back to the wall; good.
I slowly tighten the circle.
What you cannot hear is me.
I drop and seize your shoulders.
My claws tear at your back.
My teeth close on your neck.
That one came with a burst of sound.
You are flung to the ground.

lines.zh: 我抓着中小型的东西往上带。
lines.en: I snatch up smaller things and lift.

lines.zh: 这一下震得你的护甲都在响。
lines.en: That set your armour ringing.
I come at you from behind your flank.
The sound wave drives you back.
I come down and bear on you.

lines.zh: 空谷的深处传来一声长鸣。
lines.en: A long cry comes from deep in the vale.
I descend from above, slowly.
You feel the air trembling first.
A sheet of black spreads down from the roof.

lines.zh: 空谷里先响起我的长鸣。
lines.en: My long cry sounds first through the hollow valley.

lines.zh: 我落在你面前，翼还没收。
lines.en: I land before you, wings still spread.
I call out, and the echo is long.
This whole area suddenly goes quiet.
I rise from deep in the ground.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓从黑暗里凝出来。
lines.en: My outline thickens out of the dark.

lines.zh: 火一照，我的身体缩了一下。
lines.en: Fire's light makes my body shrink.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，翼膜翻过来。
lines.en: I fall from a height and my membrane folds back.

lines.zh: 水一闷，我的声音传不远。
lines.en: Under water my sound cannot carry.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，我在空中翻滚。
lines.en: The blast flips me and I tumble in the air.

lines.zh: 箭穿了我的翼，我晃了一下。
lines.en: An arrow pierces my wing and I lurch.

lines.zh: 法术打来，我的音波被压住。
lines.en: Magic hits and my sound waves are smothered.

lines.zh: 很久没抓到东西，我飞得慢了。
lines.en: Nothing caught in a long while, and I fly slower.

lines.zh: 雷光一照，我的黑影散开。
lines.en: The flash scatters my dark shape.

lines.zh: 虚空吸我，我翼膜拍不动了。
lines.en: The void pulls and my wings beat nothing.
